subject: Quick close: trial supplement to bridge to PO
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Cruz <sylvia@fastcart.io>
Cc: Markus Engel <markus@fastcart.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick close: trial supplement to bridge to PO

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks again for the chat earlier. FastCart is exactly the kind of early win we want to get live on Redwood. I know procurement needs a written offer, so to unblock the PO and give your team runway to validate, we'd like to offer a small trial supplement and a short extension. Proposal below: 

- One-time trial supplement: $3,000 in service credits (applied to hosted usage)
- Trial extension: 30 days beyond your current trial window
- Valid if PO is submitted by 2027-04-05 and signed DocuSign returned

I've attached a usage snapshot for the POC to justify the uplift and a draft SOW (FastCart_SOW_v2.pdf). If this works, I'll get Marissa to sign off and we can route a concise DocuSign addendum for procurement.

Next steps / ask: Can you confirm procurement's preferred signable format and whether they need SOC2 evidence attached? If you want a slightly larger supplement we can escalate, but this is the fastest path we can execute this week.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: usage-snapshot-2027-03-28.csv (csv), FastCart_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Sylvia Cruz <sylvia@fastcart.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fastcart.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick close: trial supplement to bridge to PO

Ben —

Appreciate the fast follow. Procurement will need: a short formal addendum (one page), the exact credit amount called out, and a DocuSign envelope. They also want to see SOC 2 Type II evidence or an attestation URL before signing. Markus from Product is looped for technical validation.

Two quick questions: 1) is the $3k applied only to hosted API usage or can it be used for dedicated testing? 2) Can you get approval today so procurement can kick the DocuSign?

If you can get a signable addendum and the SOC2 link today, we can aim to return the signed DocuSign by EOW.

—Sylvia
Sylvia Cruz | Head of Product, FastCart
sylvia@fastcart.io
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sylvia Cruz <sylvia@fastcart.io>, Markus Engel <markus@fastcart.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Mar 2027 17:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick close: trial supplement to bridge to PO — approval request

Marissa —

Forwarding Sylvia's note from FastCart. They need a one-page addendum and the SOC2 link to get procurement to sign this week. They asked if we can approve $3k as a trial supplement applied to hosted usage (their initial POC is on our hosted API). If possible I'd like to ship this today to hit their internal cadence.

Proposed offer (for sign-off):
- $3,000 hosted-service credit applied against invoiced usage
- 30-day trial extension from current trial end date
- Condition: PO submitted and DocuSign signed by 2027-04-05

I think this is a low-cost accelerator to convert; FastCart's usage snapshot shows steady token growth and a quick ramp. If you prefer a smaller amount we can offer $2k and loop legal — but that will slow things down.

I attached the usage CSV and draft SOW for context.

Thanks —
Ben

Attachments: usage-snapshot-2027-03-28.csv, FastCart_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sylvia Cruz <sylvia@fastcart.io>, Markus Engel <markus@fastcart.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick close: trial supplement to bridge to PO — approval request

Ben / Grace —

I reviewed the usage snapshot and spoke briefly with finance. Approve a one-time $3,000 trial supplement but let's cap the credit application to hosted API usage only (no dedicated instances) and it must be used within 60 days of activation. Please document this as an addendum and send to procurement via DocuSign.

Operational notes:
- Credit code / memo to include: RDW-FAST-TRIAL-2027
- Finance will reconcile against final invoice; Grace, please confirm accounting workflow and GL code.
- For SOC2: link to our compliance portal is fine for procurement; attach the SOC2 attestation PDF if requested.

Ben — proceed to finalize the one-page addendum. Copy me on the DocuSign envelope.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Sylvia / Procurement —

Thanks — quick update and next steps: per Marissa's approval we can confirm the following signable offer.

Offer (signable addendum attached):
- One-time hosted-service credit: $3,000 (RDW-FAST-TRIAL-2027)
- Trial extension: 30 days from your current trial end date
- Credit redeemable against hosted API usage only; must be used within 60 days of activation
- Condition: PO submitted and DocuSign returned by 2027-04-05

I've attached the one-page addendum (FastCart_SOW_v2.pdf) and included the SOC2 attestation link in the DocuSign notes. DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/fastcart/RDW-FAST-2027 (please review and sign).

Kindly sign by 2027-04-05 to ensure credits are applied. Once signed I'll confirm activation and forward the credit code to your billing contact. Let me know if procurement needs a specific purchase order language — we can add a short clause to the addendum.
